# Metrices 'Precision Value', 'Recall Value', 'F-score Value'
def plot_metrics(df,metrics,**kwargs):
    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6),dpi=600)

    # Corresponding colors for each metric
    colors = ['blue', 'green', 'red', 'purple', 'orange',]

    for metric, color in zip(metrics, colors):
        plt.plot(df.iloc[:,0], df[metric], label=metric, color=color)

    plt.xlabel('Validation instance',fontsize=18,fontweight='bold')
    plt.ylabel('Performance',fontsize=18,fontweight='bold')

    if 'title' in kwargs:
      title = kwargs['title']
      plt.title(title)

    plt.legend(fontsize=12, loc='best', frameon=True)
    plt.xticks(fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')  # Bolden x-axis tick labels
    plt.yticks(fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
    plt.grid(True)

    # Save figure
    if 'filename' in kwargs:
      plt.savefig(kwargs['filename'],dpi=600)

    plt.show()

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import gaussian_kde
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score

def parity_plot(x, y,title,x_label,y_label,filename):
    # Calculate the point density
    xy = np.vstack([x,y])
    z = gaussian_kde(xy)(xy)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    scatter = ax.scatter(x, y, c=z, s=2, cmap='gist_rainbow_r')  # Reverse the colormap
    ax.plot([min(x), max(x)], [min(y), max(y)], 'r-')
    plt.xlabel(x_label)
    plt.ylabel(y_label)
    #plt.title(title)
    plt.grid(True)

    # Add a colorbar
    cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter)
    cbar.set_label('Density')

    # Calculate and print the R-squared value
    r_squared = r2_score(y, x)
    print(r_squared)
    plt.text(0.05, 0.95, f'R² = {r_squared:.2f}', transform=ax.transAxes)

    # Save figure
    plt.savefig(filename,dpi=600,bbox_inches='tight')

    plt.show()

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score

def parity_plot(x, y):
    # Calculate the distance of each point from the parity line (y=x)
    distances = np.abs(y - x)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    scatter = ax.scatter(x, y, c=distances, s=100, cmap='gist_rainbow_r')
    ax.plot([min(x), max(x)], [min(y), max(y)], 'r-')
    plt.xlabel('X')
    plt.ylabel('Y')
    plt.title('Parity Plot')

    # Add a colorbar
    cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter)
    cbar.set_label('Distance from parity')

    # Calculate and print the R-squared value
    r_squared = r2_score(y, x)
    plt.text(0.05, 0.95, f'R² = {r_squared:.2f}', transform=ax.transAxes)

    plt.show()

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def plot_two_arrays_against_y(X1, X2, Y, filename, label1='X1', label2='X2'):
    fig, ax1 = plt.subplots()

    # Plot X1 and X2 against Y with different markers and line styles
    ax1.plot(Y, X1, 'o--', color='blue', label=label1, linewidth=2, markersize=8)
    ax1.plot(Y, X2, 'o--', color='red', label=label2, linewidth=2, markersize=8)

    # Add labels
    plt.xlabel('Data size [K]', fontsize=12)
    plt.ylabel('MAE [g/L]', fontsize=12)

    # Customize tick parameters to show only the given X values
    plt.xticks(Y, fontsize=14)
    plt.yticks(fontsize=14)

    # Add horizontal grid lines only with customized style
    plt.grid(True, which='major', axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)

    # Add legend with custom labels
    plt.legend(loc='upper right', fontsize=12)

    # Save figure with 600 dpi
    plt.savefig(filename, dpi=600, bbox_inches='tight')

    # Show plot
    plt.show()
